obligations.question: Which callers reach the declared numbered-load and reader roots, and how do they consume full-width results on complete, partial-read and failed-copy paths?
Which allocations, saved-resource lengths and restored pointers admit SAVE/5 and SAVE/6 into the combatant and details tables?
Which callback targets reached through the input and window services called by the declared cleanup and region-setup roots are admitted on the numbered-load path?
Do the reached children named by FND-SAVE-022 and FND-COMBAT-079/080 preserve the restored tables through return, including archive and allocation failure branches?
Does any admitted continuation of the declared numbered-load roots reload creature resources or reset current hit points after the saved-table reads?
Can original save-call admission include populated presentation slot 319 after indexed or bulk writes, and which reclamation effects follow if it can?
Which admitted callbacks in the numbered-load closure can change current or maximum hit points, and what do those concrete targets do?
Which completed branch, child and storage-identity readings prove the final current and maximum hit points for admitted complete and partial loads?
